text: No Jetson code, roles, playbooks, deploy target, scripts, CI jobs, tests or live docs remain (docs/plans archive files stay untouched).
nodes/stereo_depth and nodes/stereo_depth_cpp sources are deleted (and their node_cpu_compare entries); shared/ros2_common_cpp/depth_wire.hpp is deleted.

The web_ui Head tab is configured with /tof/depth/image_raw and /tof/amplitude/image_raw (camera_info /tof/camera_info) and the head RGB camera /front_camera/image_raw/compressed (user, 2026-10-18: Camera Module 3 + ToF form the pan/tilt head; no separate front/back cameras); the fused-depth topic and raw/fused toggle are removed from the code, not just config.
The Arm tab and mcp_server / claude_agent use /front_camera/image_raw/compressed instead of /overview_camera; the web_ui Overview tab is removed.
The web_ui Calibrate page is IMU-only: depthd_url and the stereo calibration proxy and frontend stereoApi are gone; CalibrationConfig no longer requires depthd_url.
jetson_bridge_cpp stays as a ros2_nodes entry with present: false so the next deploy uninstalls it; the uninstall also purges its colcon build/install output and stamps from /opt/ros2-ws.

The client side of jetson_link is undone by an idempotent removal task: eth0 netplan stanza, /etc/hosts entry, ip_forward sysctl, nftables NAT/forward rules; chrony stays on the client with plain internet pools (no Jetson serving).
The network role's extra-Ethernet-link support (network_link_ethernets / network_netplan_superseded_files) and the monitoring host_targets / target.host support are removed as Jetson-only features.

All suites green: root pytest, uv run poe lint, lint-nodes, lint-ansible, test-ansible, web_ui pytest + frontend tests/build, mcp_server pytest; READMEs, tests/README.md, MEMORY.md and .claude/skills updated; client deployed.
Decision 1: delete the stereo_depth and stereo_depth_cpp sources too.
Decision 2: drop the fused topic and the raw/fused toggle from the Head tab code.
Decision 3: the client keeps chrony with plain pools.
Decision 4: remove network_link_ethernets / network_netplan_superseded_files and the monitoring host_targets / target.host support.

Decision 5: Head tab = ToF depth + amplitude with RGB from the Camera Module 3 head camera (/front_camera/image_raw/compressed, amended 2026-10-18); the Arm tab and mcp_server / claude_agent use /front_camera/image_raw/compressed; drop the web_ui Overview tab.
Decision 6: the Calibrate page is IMU-only; drop depthd_url, the stereo proxy and stereoApi.
Decision 7: jetson_bridge_cpp is kept as a present: false entry for the uninstall.
Decision 8: the uninstall also purges jetson_bridge_cpp's colcon output and stamps in /opt/ros2-ws.
